subject: EdgeConf sponsor assets: asset orchestration + demo runcheck
messages:

Subject: EdgeConf booth + sponsor talk — final asset deadlne and AV notes

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick note from the EdgeConf production team — we need the finalized speaker one-pager, three short case-study blurbs, and the 10-minute demo script by COB Friday (11/05) so our ops team can do the final run-through and rack the AV. Also flagging the AV window: we have a dedicated 15-minute rehearsal slot for sponsors on Saturday 11/13 at 10:30AM PT.

For branding, please upload the hi-res logos (SVG/PNG) and the final booth slide (16:9) to the shared Drive folder. We'll keep the live-video encoder to 720p; if you need higher-res sources please let us know ASAP.

Attachments requested on our side: signed sponsor agreement (we have a DocuSign link) and the final speaker name spelling for badges.

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Wu
Senior Producer, EdgeConf
[attachments: none]

Hi Elaine — thanks for the heads up. We can hit that Friday COB deadline. High level plan:

- Deliverables: speaker one-pager, demo script (10min), 3x case blurbs (30-45 words each), hi-res logos, booth slide (16:9).
- Owners: Soojin — speaker one-pager + branding, Marissa — case blurbs + slide copy, Ben — demo script + AV checklist, Karthik — demo QA + localized notes for EU/APAC partners (if required).
- Where: uploading to Drive folder you sent; final files zipped and uploaded by 4pm PT Friday so EdgeConf can ingest.

I've attached the draft speaker one-pager for review (speaker_onepager.docx) and a first-pass demo script (demo_script_v1.md). Please confirm the rehearsal window/time — we'll reserve the team.

Soojin Lee

[attachments: speaker_onepager.docx, demo_script_v1.md]

All — quick editorial pass from content: 

- Case blurbs: I'll draft three distinct angles (cost/cost-per-token reduction, latency/resilience anecdote, and a short customer quote about migrating to Dedicated). Each ~35 words. I'll drop acme_case_blurbs.txt into Drive by EOD Thursday.
- Booth slide: I'll swap the lead headline to "Make Inference Predictable at Scale" and tighten the bullets to two lines max.
- Speaker one-pager: Soojin — I made three inline copy edits to tighten the demo outcomes (see comments in the attached .docx).

Also: quick ask for legal — if we reference a customer by name in a blurb, we need written approval. Acme (cc'd) — can you confirm a short quote sign-off by Thursday?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Writer, Redwood Inference
[attachments: edgeconf_agenda_v3.pdf, comments in speaker_onepager.docx]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: EdgeConf booth + sponsor talk — final asset deadlne and AV notes

AV and demo flow notes from engineering side: 

- Demo timing: 10 minutes live + 3 minutes buffer for Q&A. Recommend: 3 min intro (context + problem), 5 min live demo (walkthrough of latency demo + token-cost dashboard), 2 min wrap (how to get started + CTA).
- Local connection: we'll use a small local dataset (sanitized) — confirm with security that 3rd-party encoder meets our live-data policy.
- AV checklist: laptop HDMI -> house encoder; confirm HDMI passthrough resolution (Elaine listed 720p). We'll prepare a secondary presentation laptop in case of driver issues.

Uploading the detailed demo runbook to Drive now. I'll be available for the rehearsal slot on 11/13 10:30AM PT.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachments: demo_runbook_engineering.pdf]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Thanks team — consolidated checklist below and next steps. Please treat as the single source of truth for Friday deliverables.

Consolidated deliverables (due Friday 11/05 by 4:00PM PT):
1) speaker_onepager.docx — FINAL (Soojin owner) — uploaded to Drive, comments resolved.
2) acme_case_blurbs.txt — FINAL (Marissa owner) — includes one customer-approved quote; Acme please confirm sign-off by Thursday EOD.
3) demo_script_v1.md — FINAL (Ben owner) — includes AV cues and exact timestamps for the 10-minute block.
4) edgeconf_agenda_v3.pdf — conference agenda for booth staffing (Marissa owner)
5) logo_pack.zip — hi-res logos + mono white version (Soojin owner)

AV / run rehearsal: Confirmed for Saturday 11/13 10:30AM PT — Ben will lead. Arrival time for sponsors: 9:30AM for setup.

Security note: demo uses sanitized dataset; Karthik please confirm that no PII flows to the encoder and that we have a signed Data Processing Addendum uploaded to the DocuSign link.

Next steps: everyone, please upload final files by 4:00PM PT Friday and drop a quick note here when complete. Elaine — confirm the ingest of our zip and that 720p is acceptable for the live stream.

Thanks — see you at rehearsal.

Soojin Lee
Senior Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
